verdict.rationale: Discord's interactions docs describe buttons as customizable clickable components and modals as single-user pop-up forms, and message components let users invoke apps natively in chat. The Embedded App SDK adds richer interactive experiences inside Discord. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of structured message layouts (e.g. embeds, layout or container components, select menus), in-depth docs beyond one-line summaries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
